name: dotnet
description: Trailbeam.Sqs (.NET): TrailbeamSqs.Register() at startup adds a pipeline handler to every AWS SDK for .NET v4 SQS client. Build first: dotnet build -c Release conformance/drivers/dotnet.

variants.name: alone
variants.about: only Trailbeam: one line at startup, no other tracing

variants.name: app-otel
variants.about: the application's own tracer provider with OpenTelemetry.Instrumentation.AWS 1.21.0, set up before Trailbeam: every span is a child of the SDK's exported span for the call

variants.name: app-otel-trailbeam-first
variants.about: as app-otel, with Trailbeam registered before the stock instrumentation: the order of the two pipeline customizers must not matter

variants.name: app-otel-sampled-0
variants.about: as app-otel, with the application's sampler at 0%: Trailbeam's always-on provider must still export every span, each a child of the stock (unexported) span

variants.name: capture
variants.about: body capture on for every queue (contract 15): every send and receive must carry the body
